text:
alex: quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's hotpath OOM. summary: shard residency growth from long-lived streams + delayed eviction, fragmentation spike on 48GB nodes. listing proposed remediation + owners. :spiral_notepad:

maria: can we get a short actionable checklist so infra can plan a patch release? :thumbsup:

sahil: initial profiling: heap snapshot at t0 shows +1.1GB/hr in cached kv segments, jemalloc retained > rss by ~10%. suspect stale refs from stream session cleanup. uploading profiles to perf bucket.

jun: logs from pod pre-OOM: ```
2026-02-14T09:03:12Z ERROR runtime: allocation failed: cannot allocate 512MB
pid=2345 mem_used=47.8GB rss=48.2GB frag=9%
```

alex: short action items:
- A1: jemalloc arena dump & distributed heap scan on canaries — owner: @sahil — due: 2026-02-18
- A2: add softlimit for shard-residency (evict after 30m idle) in canary configs — owner: @maria — due: 2026-02-17
- A3: incremental KV compaction pass to reduce fragment slots (runtime patch) — owner: @jun — due: 2026-02-24
- A4: add metric "kv_stale_sessions" and alert at 1000+ — owner: @ops-runbook — due: 2026-02-16
- A5: emergency rollback plan doc and rollout gates for canary->prod — owner: @alex — due: 2026-02-15

sahil: started A1 — uploading jemalloc dumps to gs://redwood-perf/oom/1767770000/ and will attach flamegraphs.

maria: A2 will be pushed to staging first; flips eviction TTL only.

jun: question on A3: background compaction thread vs opportunistic on-request? leaning background with token-bucket rate limit to limit CPU.

alex: prefer background with cap + feature flag; ensure respects dedicated pool QoS.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: canary config change scheduled 2026-02-16 03:00 UTC (staging) by maria. CI: green. :robot_face:

maria: test plan: create 50 long-lived sessions (10m-60m) on staging, monitor kv_residency_size, kv_fragmentation, jemalloc.retained_bytes; run 6h, capture hourly heap dumps.

ops-runbook: added runbook entry "hotpath OOM pulse" -> run A1, check kv_stale_sessions, escalate to eng-runtime-sre if trend > +20%/hr. added Slack escalation template.

alex: risk: compaction could spike tail latency. rollout: rate-limit + 5% canary; rollback if p95 > baseline+20ms.

sahil: uploaded artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/oom/1767770000/{jemalloc.dmp,heap-flame-1.svg}. will post diffs.

maria: validating A2 after staging deploy; will post results.

jun: starting compaction worker prototype, PR ETA 2026-02-19.

alex: reconvene Fri 2026-02-19 16:00 UTC (30m). agenda: A1 results, staging A2 metrics, compaction perf.

all: ack.

alex: reminder: include one-line backward-compatible fallback flag for quick toggle. :memo:

sahil: note: if jemalloc.retained >> rss that's fragmentation — prioritize compaction over aggressive eviction until data shows otherwise.

ops-runbook: heuristic added: "if jemalloc.retained_bytes / rss > 1.08 -> flag fragmentation priority".

alex: closing for now. update thread when due dates hit or blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
